nodes.description: The study of algorithms and statistical models that enable computers to perform tasks without explicit instructions.
nodes.sub_topics: [{"name": "Supervised Learning", "description": "A type of machine learning where the model is trained on labeled data."}, {"name": "Unsupervised Learning", "description": "A type of machine learning that deals with unlabeled data to find hidden patterns."}, {"name": "Semi-Supervised Learning", "description": "A blend of supervised and unsupervised learning using both labeled and unlabeled data."}]
nodes.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of programming and statistics.
nodes.common_misconceptions: ["Machine learning is the same as artificial intelligence.", "More data always leads to better models."]

nodes.description: A subset of machine learning that uses neural networks with many layers.
nodes.sub_topics: [{"name": "Neural Networks", "description": "Computational models inspired by the human brain, consisting of interconnected nodes."}, {"name": "Activation Functions", "description": "Functions that determine the output of a neural network node."}, {"name": "Backpropagation", "description": "An algorithm for training neural networks by minimizing the error."}]
nodes.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of linear algebra, calculus, and programming in Python.
nodes.common_misconceptions: ["Deep learning is the same as machine learning.", "More layers always lead to better performance."]

nodes.description: An optimization algorithm used to minimize the loss function in machine learning models.
nodes.sub_topics: [{"name": "Learning Rate", "description": "A hyperparameter that controls how much to change the model in response to the estimated error."}, {"name": "Stochastic Gradient Descent", "description": "A variant of gradient descent that updates the model using a single training example."}]
nodes.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of calculus and linear algebra.
nodes.common_misconceptions: ["Gradient descent always finds the global minimum.", "A smaller learning rate is always better."]
nodes.practical_applications: ["Training neural networks", "Linear regression optimization", "Logistic regression", "Support vector machines"]

nodes.description: Functions that measure how well a machine learning model performs.
nodes.sub_topics: [{"name": "Mean Squared Error", "description": "A common loss function for regression tasks."}, {"name": "Cross-Entropy Loss", "description": "A loss function often used for classification tasks."}]
nodes.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of machine learning and statistics.
nodes.common_misconceptions: ["Loss functions only measure accuracy.", "All loss functions are the same."]

nodes.description: A type of predictive modeling technique that estimates relationships among variables.
nodes.sub_topics: [{"name": "Linear Regression", "description": "A method for modeling the relationship between a scalar response and one or more explanatory variables."}, {"name": "Logistic Regression", "description": "A statistical method for predicting binary classes."}]
nodes.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of statistics and algebra.
nodes.common_misconceptions: ["Regression implies causation", "Only linear relationships can be modeled"]
nodes.practical_applications: ["Predicting sales based on advertising spend", "Estimating housing prices based on features"]

nodes.description: The task of predicting the category of a given data point.
nodes.sub_topics: [{"name": "Binary Classification", "description": "A classification task with two possible outcomes."}, {"name": "Multi-Class Classification", "description": "A classification task with more than two possible outcomes."}]
nodes.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of statistics and programming.
nodes.common_misconceptions: ["Classification is only for binary outcomes.", "More features always improve classification accuracy."]

nodes.description: A type of model architecture that uses self-attention mechanisms for processing sequential data.
nodes.sub_topics: [{"name": "Self-Attention", "description": "A mechanism that allows the model to weigh the importance of different words in a sequence."}, {"name": "Transformer Architecture", "description": "The structure of the transformer model, including encoder and decoder components."}]
nodes.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of neural networks and sequence data processing.
nodes.common_misconceptions: ["Transformers are only for NLP tasks", "Self-attention replaces RNNs completely"]
nodes.practical_applications: ["Natural language processing", "Image processing", "Speech recognition", "Time series forecasting"]

nodes.description: The branch of mathematics concerned with the analysis of random phenomena.
nodes.sub_topics: [{"name": "Bayesian Inference", "description": "A method of statistical inference in which Bayes' theorem is used to update the probability of a hypothesis."}, {"name": "Random Variables", "description": "Variables whose values are determined by the outcomes of a random phenomenon."}]
nodes.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of algebra and statistics.
nodes.key_sub_concepts: ["Random Variables", "Probability Distributions", "Bayes' Theorem", "Law of Large Numbers"]
nodes.common_misconceptions: ["Probability is the same as chance", "Independent events cannot affect each other"]
nodes.practical_applications: ["Risk assessment in finance", "Machine learning algorithms", "Statistical inference", "Quality control in manufacturing"]

nodes.description: The process of creating and developing new products and systems.
nodes.sub_topics: [{"name": "Product Design", "description": "The process of creating a new product to be sold by a business to its customers."}, {"name": "System Design", "description": "The process of defining the architecture, components, modules, interfaces, and data for a system."}]
nodes.prerequisites_summary: Basic understanding of engineering principles and design processes.
nodes.common_misconceptions: ["Design engineering is only about aesthetics.", "It does not involve technical skills."]
